name: Unknown API match returns 404 JSON with error and code
description: Unknown API match returns 404 JSON with error and code.

planSteps.description: Request /api/match/this-does-not-exist/odds (or the app's equivalent unknown-match API path)
Verify the response is HTTP 404 and the body is JSON containing an `error` message and a `code` field — not HTML and not a 200.
